lines.en: The ocelot pads along the roots.
Its shoulders roll with each stride.

lines.zh: 斑纹在斑驳的光里散开
lines.en: Its markings break up in the dappled light.
Each step lands very lightly.
Its tail rides level behind it.
It slips under a bush.
It passes a trunk with its body turned.
It stops mid-stride.
It walks the rim of a puddle.
Its claws stay sheathed as it walks.
It follows a narrow animal trail.
It crosses a fallen log in silence.
The ocelot sits, tail tip flicking.
It licks its front paw.

lines.zh: 耳朵转向声音来的方向
lines.en: An ear swivels toward a sound.

lines.zh: 它眯起眼，享受这片阴凉
lines.en: It squints into the shade.
Its whiskers tremble.

lines.zh: 它把身体拉长，伸了个懒腰
lines.en: It stretches itself long.
Its breathing is slow and even.
It looks up at birds in the tree.
It paws the leaf litter twice.

lines.zh: 它忽然转头，像听见什么
lines.en: It snaps its head up at a sound.
It rubs its cheek on bark.
It rests its chin on a paw.
I blink slowly, tail tip twitching.

lines.zh: 斑点让它的轮廓变模糊
lines.en: Its spots blur its outline.
The ocelot looks up, direct.

lines.zh: 它歪头打量你，不急着动
lines.en: It tilts its head without hurrying.
Its pupils narrow to slits.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴慢慢摇了一下
lines.en: Its tail swings once.
Its hind legs draw in slightly.

lines.zh: 它从你影子里往后退了半步
lines.en: It backs half a step out of your shadow.

lines.zh: 它嗅了嗅你脚边的空气
lines.en: It sniffs the air by your feet.
Its whiskers fan forward.
No hostility, only wariness.
It circles a slow half turn around you.
It watches your hands unblinking.
It loads its weight onto the hind legs.

lines.zh: 它看起来想走，又不想输
lines.en: It looks ready to leave but unwilling to.

lines.zh: 它对你低声哈了一下气
lines.en: It huffs a quiet warning at you.
It curls its tail around its feet.
It holds still, letting you move first.

lines.zh: 它衡量你的高度，退了半步
lines.en: It measures your height and backs off.
Then it is gone into the brush.
Hurt, the ocelot bolts clear.

lines.zh: 它落地时歪了一下身子
lines.en: It lands slightly crooked.
It glances back at the wound.
Growling, it retreats behind a tree.
Blood shows along its markings.
It licks the wound and looks up.
Its ears flatten further.
Its breathing runs fast.

lines.zh: 它退了两步，重新压低身体
lines.en: It backs two steps and crouches again.
It stops probing and gets serious.
The ocelot fixes on the meat.

lines.zh: 它鼻尖抽动，闻到了血味
lines.en: Its nose works at the smell of blood.

lines.zh: 它伏低身子，一点点靠近
lines.en: It lowers itself and creeps in.
It reaches, then withdraws.

lines.zh: 它绕到侧面，想绕开你的手
lines.en: It works round to your blind side.
It bites and drags the meat off.

lines.zh: 它咬着东西退到树后吃
lines.en: It carries it behind a tree to eat.
Afterward it licks its mouth.
It returns and sits for another.

lines.zh: 它靠得很近，尾巴翘起来了
lines.en: It comes close, tail lifted.

lines.zh: 虎猫被撞得一跳，落开两格
lines.en: The ocelot springs clear of the bump.
It lands and turns at once.

lines.zh: 它的肩撞在你腿上，很轻
lines.en: Its shoulder taps your leg.

lines.zh: 它侧身滑过去，没碰到你
lines.en: It slides by without touching you.

lines.zh: 它甩了下尾巴，跳上矮枝
lines.en: A flick of the tail, and it is on a branch.
It looks down at you from above.

lines.zh: 它的爪子在你袖子上勾了一下
lines.en: A claw snags your sleeve.

lines.zh: 它落地时几乎没有声音
lines.en: It lands almost soundlessly.

lines.zh: 它退进草丛，只露出眼睛
lines.en: It backs into the grass, eyes only.

lines.zh: 它确认你没追，才放松下来
lines.en: Sure you are not chasing, it relaxes.
Two ocelots circle one another.
Their noses touch once.
They sit together on a fallen log.

lines.zh: 一只替另一只理了理耳后
lines.en: One grooms behind the other's ear.

lines.zh: 它们的尾巴交叠在一起
lines.en: Their tails lie across each other.

lines.zh: 它们一前一后钻进灌木
lines.en: They slip into the brush one after the other.

lines.zh: 它们把额头轻轻顶在一起
lines.en: They press their foreheads together.
Their breathing syncs quickly.

lines.zh: 它们像两块会呼吸的斑影
lines.en: They look like two breathing patches of shade.

lines.zh: 这片林子安静了一小会
lines.en: The wood is quiet for a little while.

lines.zh: 虎猫一爪按住掉落的肉
lines.en: The ocelot pins the fallen meat.

lines.zh: 它低头把东西衔在齿间
lines.en: It takes the item in its teeth.

lines.zh: 它把东西拖到树根底下
lines.en: It drags it under the roots.

lines.zh: 它用爪子拨了拨，确认能咬
lines.en: A paw tests whether it can be bitten.

lines.zh: 它咬着东西，尾巴翘得高
lines.en: It carries it off, tail high.
It crunches the bone.
It buries the leftovers in leaves.
It tosses the catch and catches it.
It takes it up into the tree.
Having eaten, it washes its face.

lines.zh: 虎猫的耳朵一下贴平了
lines.en: The ocelot's ears flatten.

lines.zh: 它的后腿已经蓄好了力
lines.en: Its hind legs are already loaded.

lines.zh: 喉咙里滚出低低的警告
lines.en: A low warning rolls in its throat.
It drops lower, shoulders rising.
Its pupils go nearly round.
Its tail strikes the ground once.

lines.zh: 它把你锁进了视野正中
lines.en: It has you dead centre in its sight.
It starts a slow sideways drift.

lines.zh: 它把爪子从掌里伸出来
lines.en: Its claws slide out.
Every whisker comes forward.
It has measured the leap.
Its breathing turns shallow.

lines.zh: 它压低身体，像贴在土上
lines.en: It presses flat to the soil.

lines.zh: 它把注意力全放在你喉咙
lines.en: Its whole attention is on your throat.
It eases back half a step to gather.

lines.zh: 下一瞬间它就会扑上来
lines.en: The next instant it will spring.

lines.zh: 虎猫跟着你的脚步移动
lines.en: The ocelot moves with your steps.
It passes from one side to the other.

lines.zh: 它试着冲了一步又停住
lines.en: It darts a step and halts.

lines.zh: 它的爪子还没完全伸出
lines.en: Its claws are not fully out yet.

lines.zh: 它在等你转身露出后颈
lines.en: It waits for your neck to turn.
It keeps itself very low.

lines.zh: 尾巴慢慢地摆，像在计时
lines.en: Its tail swings as if keeping time.

lines.zh: 它发出一声短促的哈气
lines.en: It gives a short warning hiss.
It hops onto a stump for height.
From up there it sees better.

lines.zh: 它试着从你的盲侧靠近
lines.en: It probes your blind side.
You move; it gives half a step.
Then it starts pressing in again.

lines.zh: 它的影子和你影子重叠了
lines.en: Its shadow overlaps yours.

lines.zh: 它随时能跳开，也随时能扑
lines.en: It can leap away or in, at will.
It is weighing the cost.
Its patience runs longer than you think.

lines.zh: 只要一个破绽，它就会来
lines.en: One gap and it will come.
The ocelot springs, claws first.

lines.zh: 它抓在你手臂上，四道白痕
lines.en: Four pale lines open on your arm.
It snaps at your wrist.

lines.zh: 它一击不中，落地就滚开
lines.en: Missing, it lands and rolls clear.
It leaps for your face.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴一甩，转身再扑
lines.en: A tail flick, a turn, another leap.

lines.zh: 它咬住你的袖子往后扯
lines.en: It bites your sleeve and pulls.
Its hind legs kick your knee.
Two quick rakes and it is gone.
A claw hooks into the cloth.

lines.zh: 它绕到你背后再扑一次
lines.en: It rounds your back and springs again.
It bites air; teeth click loudly.

lines.zh: 它贴地一窜，从你腿间穿过
lines.en: It streaks between your legs.

lines.zh: 它跳回枝上，喘着气看你
lines.en: It leaps to a branch and watches, panting.
A forepaw swats your boot.

lines.zh: 这一下只是试探，不是全力
lines.en: That was a test, not full force.
Two yellow points light in the bush.

lines.zh: 虎猫从叶影里现出身形
lines.en: The ocelot resolves out of the leaves.
It puts out one forepaw first.
Then the rest of it follows.
It shakes the leaves off its back.

lines.zh: 它蹲在倒木上打量四周
lines.en: It sits on a log and surveys.

lines.zh: 它的斑纹让轮廓碎成几块
lines.en: Its markings break its outline apart.
It drops down without a sound.
Its tail sweeps the grass aside first.
It walks the trail into the clearing.
It pauses in a patch of light.

lines.zh: 我缩在藤影里，尾巴不动。
lines.en: In the vine shadow, my tail stays still.
Ears move first, body after.

lines.zh: 它看起来已经完全属于这里
lines.en: It looks entirely at home here.

lines.zh: 它的胡须上还挂着露水
lines.en: Dew still clings to its whiskers.

lines.zh: 它慢慢地在你面前坐了下来
lines.en: It settles down in front of you.
It makes no sound, only watches.

lines.zh: 林子里的鸟忽然都停了
lines.en: Suddenly every bird in the wood stops.
Singed fur sends it springing away.

lines.zh: 摔在地上，它翻身就站起
lines.en: It hits the ground and rolls upright.

lines.zh: 它在水里扑腾，拼命划前爪
lines.en: It thrashes, forepaws clawing at the water.
The blast throws it into the bushes.

lines.zh: 箭擦过它的胁腹，带走一撮毛
lines.en: An arrow grazes its flank and takes fur.
Odd force makes its whole body jerk.

lines.zh: 饿得站不稳，它还在瞪着
lines.en: Starving and unsteady, it still glares.

lines.zh: 雷击让它僵在地上，毛全立起
lines.en: Lightning locks it stiff, fur on end.

lines.zh: 虚空一吸，它四爪拼命抓地
lines.en: The void inhales; four claws dig in.
